Liu (CS): Heads-up: Helix Health dedicated bring-up is scheduled for Fri 08:00 UTC. Need final sign-off on quota, autoscale, warmup, and a tiny renewal-risk callout for Theo. Quick check-in?
Priya (CS): On it. Are we still doing 12 GPUs in us-central1? Also need enablement docs for their ops team.
Omar (SRE): Confirmed: 12x H100-equivalent reserved in us-central1, pool id RP-HELIX-12. I've left a +1 hot spare for emergencies.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Load plan: Stage A smoke 5m; Stage B ramp 3h to 18k RPS; Stage C 4h steady. Load command (local runner): `./rungenerator --profile helix-std --rps 18000 --seq 128 --concurrency 120 --duration 14400 --tag rollout_smoke`
Omar (SRE): Autoscale proposal (candidate): scale on throughput + latency guard. Sample YAML we can copy into control plane:
```
autoscale:
  type: throughput
  scale_up:
    condition: avg_req_per_gpu > 9000
    consecutive_seconds: 120
    add_replicas: 1
  scale_down:
    condition: avg_req_per_gpu < 5000
    consecutive_seconds: 600
    remove_replicas: 1
  min_replicas: 6
  max_replicas: 16
  latency_safety:
    p95_ms: 400
    action: block_scale_down
  cooldown_seconds: 180
```
Priya (CS): Nice. For billing ramp, Theo suggested 20% month1 / 60% month2 / 100% month3. Also note: Helix has a renewal clause tied to error budget <2% during onboarding month. Theo, confirm?
Theo (Acct): Yep that's right. If we exceed 2% errors for >3 days cumulative, renewal talks escalate. We should treat this as high priority for the first 30 days.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Cache warmup: we'll run `python warm_cache.py --keys top_10k --parallel 16 --region us-central1 --model helix-v2` 40m before traffic. WarmupBot will post completion.
WarmupBot: warmup job scheduled: warmup-helix-v2-1717905600, ETA start 1717908000 UTC.

Priya (CS): Enablement: I'll run a 45m ops walkthrough Wed 16:00 UTC. Will cover dashboard basics, throttles, and how to trigger fallback routing manually. Please add the runbook link once ready.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Acceptance checks I'm owning post-load: p95 latency < 450ms, error rate < 0.8% during steady window, and cold-start tail mitigation validated. I'll push an artifacts zip with logs and sample traces.
Omar (SRE): Monitoring checklist: pool_util, queue_depth, p50/p95 latency, replica_count, error_rate, cache_miss_rate, billing_burn. Alerts: p95>450ms, error_rate>1% (sev2), billing_burn > 140% expected (sev3).
